_meta.description: SYNTHETIC, FICTIONAL county-government knowledge base seed data for the County Assistant prototype. Inspired by the public information-architecture style of a typical county portal (departments, services, FAQs, online services, permits, taxes, health, emergency, voting, reporting concerns). All names, numbers, URLs, fees, and content are invented and must NOT be treated as real. Do not copy any real county content.
_meta.disclaimer: Fictional content for prototyping only. Not legal, financial, medical, or emergency advice.

faqs.q: How long does a building permit take?
faqs.a: Most simple residential permits in Westvale County are reviewed within 10 business days (fictional). Complex projects take longer.
Fictional schedule: first installment due Nov 1, delinquent after Dec 10; second installment due Feb 1, delinquent after Apr 10.

faqs.q: What is the voter registration deadline?
faqs.a: Fictional: register at least 15 days before an election; same-day conditional registration may be available at designated sites.

faqs.q: How do I get a birth certificate?
faqs.a: Request a certified copy online through Public Health; valid ID and a $29 (fictional) fee apply.

faqs.q: How do I sign up for emergency alerts?
faqs.a: Fictional: opt in to Westvale Alerts for evacuation, fire, and weather notices by SMS or email.
